description: Browse built-in website and store templates with search, filters, pagination, and preview links. Use this with limit=5/6 and summaryOnly=true so users are not overwhelmed.

category.description: Optional category/tag filter, e.g. fashion, beauty, restaurant, law, real-estate.

includePages.description: Include page slug/title arrays. Leave false for short chat output.

limit.description: Maximum templates to return (default 12, max 50). Use 5 or 6 for user-friendly recommendations.

offset.description: Pagination offset. Use pagination.nextOffset for the next page.

premium.description: true = premium only, false = free only, omit = both.

projectType.description: Filter by website or shop/ecommerce template.

q.description: Natural search text, e.g. "South African skincare", "coffee", "fitness", "law firm".

summaryOnly.description: When true, omits large details. Set false only when the user asks for fuller template data.

name: list_templates
